title: Product Execution Surface
description: Frontmatter and section contract for the canonical product -> operations execution surface. product/strategy/roadmap/ sequences work, product/technical/specs/ supplies executable technical specs, and product/execution/prds/ carries the integrated buildable mission.

last_reviewed.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this product surface was last reviewed for execution readiness.

source_artifact.description: Relative path to the artifact that most recently changed this product surface, if any.

spec_id.description: Stable identifier for specs and PRDs so operations artifacts can reference the implemented unit of work.

external_sources.description: External product sources this artifact depends on.

roadmap_required_body_sections.heading: Now
roadmap_required_body_sections.description: Committed or active product bets and milestones.

roadmap_required_body_sections.heading: Next
roadmap_required_body_sections.description: Likely next bets, sequencing dependencies, and decision gates.

roadmap_required_body_sections.heading: Later
roadmap_required_body_sections.description: Deferred opportunities that are known but not yet committed.

spec_required_body_sections.heading: Problem
spec_required_body_sections.description: The user or system problem this spec resolves.

spec_required_body_sections.heading: Acceptance Criteria
spec_required_body_sections.description: Observable criteria operations work must satisfy.

spec_required_body_sections.heading: Dependencies
spec_required_body_sections.description: Sequencing, design, technical, or integration dependencies.

spec_required_body_sections.heading: Evidence
spec_required_body_sections.description: Links to supporting evidence, decisions, external sources, or codebase evidence.

prd_required_body_sections.heading: Scope
prd_required_body_sections.description: What is in and out of scope for delivery.
